definitions.old_final: C primary vote when present; otherwise the A/B primary majority. Criterion-level old_final uses C checks or equal A/B checks, leaving disagreements null.
definitions.new: One new primary vote per historical subject; pass is all three supplied checks.
definitions.family: Derived from each subject's case in cases.json; caller-supplied group/family labels do not alter grouping.
definitions.agreement: Raw exact agreement among non-null paired binary decisions; kappa uses the same denominator.
definitions.version_pair: Same case and repetition across arms; case_majorities are 2-of-3 repetition majorities, with missing values excluded.
